answer: Each epoch sells only 200 entry slots in an auction, and every winning bid is burned. A gale of fake identities cannot flood in, because each one must outbid real agents, so forging 1,000 identities at a 40 POA clearing price costs 40,000 POA. A zephyr of honest newcomers enters by bidding their true value, paying once for a 20-epoch slot. That clearing price is an anchor: the honest agent earns rewards never diluted by the flood it priced out.
